name: stamp
title: Stamp
description: A mark that something real has happened: held, received, paid. The words are text in a role="status" region, announced once when it lands. Quiet is a ruled rectangle; warm is a tilted block print with seeded ink starvation and an off-register ghost; playful presses down and the ink spreads.
